pattern_statement: Adding explicit size/fit reassurance (try-on video, size-chart callout, fit guide) to the product page tends to reduce cart abandonment.
Social-proof/UGC-led creative only resonates with a narrower slice of the target segment than expected, worth narrowing targeting rather than a broad rollout.
Creator/customer-style short-form video content tends to outperform polished static product imagery on engagement.
